blogs.title: Mining Math Knowledge from the Web: How DeepSeekMath Built a 120‑Billion‑Token Corpus
blogs.description: This post walks readers through the clever data‑mining pipeline DeepSeekMath used to turn raw web pages from Common Crawl into a high‑quality, multilingual math dataset. It explains fastText classification, iterative domain filtering, de‑duplication, and benchmark de‑contamination in easy‑to‑understand terms, showing why publicly available web data can power state‑of‑the‑art math reasoning.

blogs.title: Why Teaching LLMs to Code Helps Them Solve Math Problems
blogs.description: Explore the surprising finding that pre‑training on code boosts mathematical reasoning. We'll break down the two‑stage and one‑stage training experiments, explain concepts like “catastrophic forgetting,” and illustrate how code knowledge enables both tool‑free reasoning and program‑aided problem solving for models like DeepSeekMath.

blogs.title: Reinforcement Learning Made Lean: Introducing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
blogs.description: A friendly guide to DeepSeekMath’s new RL algorithm, GRPO. The article demystifies how GRPO replaces the heavyweight critic in PPO with a simple group‑based baseline, reduces memory usage, and still delivers big performance jumps. Readers will learn about advantages, outcome vs. process supervision, and why GRPO is a game‑changer for training math‑savvy language models.

blogs.title: DeepSeekMath vs. GPT‑4: Closing the Gap in Open‑Source Math Reasoning
blogs.description: Compare DeepSeekMath’s performance on benchmarks like MATH, GSM8K, and Chinese math tests with closed‑source giants such as GPT‑4 and Gemini Ultra. The post highlights key metrics, explains what “competition‑level” means, and discusses why a 7B model can now rival models that are dozens of times larger.

blogs.title: From Chain‑of‑Thought to Program‑of‑Thought: Teaching LLMs Step‑by‑Step Reasoning
blogs.description: Delve into how DeepSeekMath uses instruction tuning with chain‑of‑thought (CoT), program‑of‑thought (PoT), and tool‐integrated reasoning formats. We'll illustrate these techniques with simple example problems, show how they improve accuracy on both pure text solutions and Python‐based computations, and explain why “thinking aloud” matters for AI.

blogs.title: Beyond Numbers: Real‑World Uses of DeepSeekMath and What Comes Next
blogs.description: This forward‑looking piece translates DeepSeekMath’s technical achievements into everyday applications—educational tutoring, automated proof assistance, scientific coding helpers, and multilingual math support. It also outlines current limitations (geometry reasoning, few‑shot performance) and future research directions such as better reward models and larger multilingual corpora.
